## Dependency Management

```{r}
renv::restore()

library(metacheck)
```

## Process batch to XML files

```{r}

#Listing all the filepaths at which the pdf's are stored
pdf_files <- list.files(
  path = "Articles_testbatch",
  pattern = "\\.pdf$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)


paper_testbatch <- convert(file_path = pdf_files,
                           save_path = "Articles_testbatch",
                           method = "grobid",
                           api_url = "https://grobidOrg-grobid.hf.space", #if the server is not active take another one from list of active servers: https://www.scienceverse.org/metacheck/convert.json
                           crossref_lookup = FALSE)

```
